name: Inayat Killi

queries.query: Inayat Killi Pakistan cadastral map land records official
queries.result: Search identified the official Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Revenue & Estate Department land-record program and its merged-district GIS settlement page. No Inayat Killi parcel viewer, public API, schema/CRS response, or safe anonymous parcel geometry was identified.

queries.result: Search returned the official Khyber Pakhtunkhwa land-record and e-stamping pages, but no Inayat Killi-specific public parcel layer or ID-plus-geometry endpoint. General national/provincial service prose was not treated as city-local evidence.

officialSources.observation: Official Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Revenue & Estate Department page states that the merged-district settlement project covers Khar Bajaur, uses GIS-based measurement, and reports 3,067 measured parcels in Khar Bajaur. It does not expose a public Inayat Killi parcel layer, native parcel IDs, geometry service, schema, or CRS in the observed page. This is provincial program evidence, not city-local service evidence.

Official Settlement & Digitization of Land Records site was identified as the merged-district GIS land-management entry point, but the anonymous request timed out before the viewer or configuration could be inspected. No absence inference was made.

Official department page describes computerized land records, mutations, Fard-e-Bader, and service delivery in selected Khyber Pakhtunkhwa districts. It does not provide an open Inayat Killi parcel geometry response and does not establish citywide coverage.
Official Khyber Pakhtunkhwa e-stamping page exposes valuation and e-registry workflows, but no public parcel geometry or safe cadastral schema for Inayat Killi.

requests.outcome: Page returned through first-party search/open inspection. It documents Khar Bajaur GIS settlement progress and parcel totals, but no public parcel ID-plus-geometry response, map endpoint, schema, or CRS was exposed.

Anonymous request timed out during DNS/connection resolution after 20 seconds. Viewer configuration and API route could not be inspected; this is an access/transport limitation, not evidence of cadastral absence.
Page returned through first-party search/open inspection. It describes land-record computerization and services, but no Inayat Killi geometry or public query schema was available.
Public workflow returned. No parcel geometry, native parcel identity, or anonymous cadastral feature response was requested or retained.

registryBasis: A provincial land-record custodian and merged-district GIS program were evidenced, but no Inayat Killi-local registry/cadastre map, public parcel service, or local custodian endpoint was actually verified.
